3163274.summary: Static constructor of the compiler-generated lambda holder for AbilityLogic. It just creates the single shared instance used by the cached lambdas.

31632f8.summary: Lambda used by GetTargets to read a unit's effective attack. It uses melee attack when melee is at least ranged, otherwise ranged attack (0 if the unit is blind), including buffs from active effects, never below 0.
comments: null unit: compiler null check
read the unit's current ranged and melee attack
melee is the higher (or equal) attack: compute the melee value
sum melee changes from active effects; a 'set melee attack' effect overrides everything and returns at once
base melee attack plus summed buff changes, clamped so it never goes below 0
ranged is higher: a blind unit counts as 0 attack
same effect loop for ranged; 'set ranged attack' effect returns its value directly
base ranged attack plus buff total, clamped to at least 0

3163310.summary: Lambda used by GetTargets that returns a unit's current health minus the summed value of certain active effects. The flag/value checks are raw memory reads, so which effects count (seems damage-like) is unclear.
comments: set up the enumerator over the unit's active effects
walk every active effect on the unit
end of list: return current health minus the accumulated effect total
only effects passing two raw field checks are summed (seems to be an enabled flag and a specific type)

3163328.summary: Lambda used by GetTargets that gives the AI a value score for a unit: in-play card value plus enchantment value, reduced when damaged and cut by 20% when stunned or pinned down.
comments: get the battle's AI manager (decompiler shows a second unset AI variable; the calls are the same manager)
base AI value of this card on the board, plus value of its enchantments
add enchantment value to the base value
damaged unit: scale value by roughly half to full according to remaining health fraction
stunned or pinned down units are worth 20% less

3163340.summary: Second lambda used by GetTargets with the same logic as its sibling: AI value of a unit including enchantments, reduced when damaged and cut by 20% when stunned or pinned down.
comments: get the battle's AI manager (decompiler shows a second unset AI variable; the calls are the same manager)
base AI value of this card on the board, plus value of its enchantments
add enchantment value to the base value
damaged unit: scale value by roughly half to full according to remaining health fraction
stunned or pinned down units are worth 20% less

315876c.summary: Makes a copy of this ability's logic so edits to the copy do not affect the original. It shallow-clones, then gives the copy its own animation list and its own copies of target, multiplier, damage, heal, hand-buff and Energy-buff criteria.
comments: shallow clone first; reference fields still point at the original's objects
decompiler type-check noise confirming the clone is an AbilityLogic
give the copy its own animation list
deep copy each criteria/buff object into the clone (nested nulls skip the rest in the output; the intent is each copied if present)
animation list copied again; decompiler duplicate
unreachable-looking error/cleanup path left by the decompiler

list has at least one entry: fetch element 0
